mapper.select: select * from t_r_data_perm_bundle_statement where bundle_id = #{bundleId} order by id asc

select b.* from t_r_data_perm_bundle_statement b left join t_r_data_perm_scope sc on sc.code = b.scope_code
b.bundle_id = #{bundleId}
and ( sc.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or exists ( select 1 from t_r_data_perm_bundle_statement_resource r where r.statement_id = b.id and (r.catalog_names like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or r.database_names like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or r.table_names like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or r.column_names like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ) or exists ( select 1 from t_r_data_perm_scope_access_group g where g.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') and JSON_CONTAINS(b.group_ids, CAST(g.id AS JSON)) ) )
order by b.id asc
select count(*) from t_r_data_perm_bundle_statement where scope_code = #{scopeCode}
select count(*) from t_r_data_perm_bundle_statement where JSON_CONTAINS(group_ids, CAST(#{groupId} AS JSON))
